children: Tessera Defense & Homeland Security entered into an option to acquire 51% of RT LTA Systems from X S.E. Security and Defense, featuring a refundable $1 million option fee and a 90-day exercise window subject to due diligence and approvals. The purchase price equals 51% of RT’s equity value, capped at $13 million or calculated via a formula tied to 2026–2028 performance, payable in cash, stock, or both. Separately, Tessera will obtain a non-exclusive, perpetual license to RT’s technology within 60 days, regardless of whether the acquisition proceeds; the license becomes royalty-free and irrevocable if refunds are not made as required. The seller agreed to a no-shop during the option period.
